backtest_params.universe: Open — every tradeable tokenized US-equity perp; screen ≥5 analysts + ≥$0.0B revenue

pnl_breakdown.residual_note: mid-cycle beta re-trim: the QQQ hedge leg is resized between rebalances, realising P&L that an entry-to-mark on the CURRENT position cannot show. Funding is now its own line rather than part of this.
pnl_breakdown.note: total is NAV-anchored (ledger-backed, never restated); the components sum to it exactly

closed_positions.reason: pre-IPO excluded from the quant book — risk policy §1.3 / Part 4 (Pre-IPO is the Fund's sole venture-style mandate)

risk_policy.policy: EMCD / Layer One Fund Risk Policy v1.9 — Part 3 (Quantitative Strategies)
risk_policy.basis: Policy basis (§1.6): limits are % of the STRATEGY NOTIONAL = allocated risk capital ($50,000). The engine's $100,000 trading notional is 2x that, so the engine's 200%-of-notional gross cap = the policy's 400% max gross (4x NAV).

items.name: Gross exposure
items.note: engine cap 200% of trading notional = 400% policy basis (exact match)

items.name: Net market exposure (beta-adjusted)
items.note: face net 65% is the 3x-SOXL artifact; the policy limit is beta-adjusted

items.name: Sleeve hard drawdown
items.limit: 20% PTT on strategy notional → flat + IC re-approval

items.name: Staged de-risking
items.note: stricter than the stepped schedule at every band — stricter provision applies (§1.1). Elastic RV function (1−dd/20%)^0.5 available via strategy sheet

items.name: Restoration hysteresis
items.measured: not implemented — engine restores continuously as DD recovers
items.note: engine restores EARLIER than policy; needs hysteresis or strategy-sheet adoption of the elastic function (which has none)

items.name: Scaling pause (drawdown)
items.limit: pause at 5% PTT of strategy notional

items.name: Fund early warning
items.limit: 4% drawdown on NAV → de-risk review, RM report

items.name: Fund gates (tracking)
items.note: contractual gates bind fund-level, monthly month-end per Annex A; shown here as strategy tracking

items.name: Mandate separation (no pre-IPO)
items.limit: pre-IPO instruments only in the Pre-IPO sleeve — none in the quant book

items.name: Per-venue concentration
items.note: non-conforming for live deployment — needs a second venue or a documented IC strategy-sheet exception before capital

items.name: Model governance
items.limit: documented methodology · RM-reviewed OOS backtest · paper period · IC strategy sheet
items.measured: methodology + backtest documented · paper track ACTIVE · RM review + IC strategy sheet PENDING
items.note: live Sharpe < ½ backtest Sharpe over a rolling quarter triggers RM review once live

items.name: Automated RMS
items.limit: independent real-time RMS: DD/exposure/leverage/concentration monitors, stops, slippage throttle, kill-switches, ADL protection
items.measured: DD ladder, exposure caps, per-name caps, beta re-trim: in engine · independent-infra RMS, kill-switches, ADL detection: go-live build
items.note: mandatory before live capital; paper phase runs engine-internal controls only

note: Simulated track: the book is re-derived each day from a rolling 252-trading-day backtest on the CURRENT universe (it re-bases when the universe changes — not a held forward paper book). Held/uPnL describe that modeled window, not realized fills. Notional $100,000. Research, not investment advice or a performance representation.
